title: Northgate Purchases & Returns: Channel Access and Assortment Schedule
content:
Every purchase recorded under Northgate Purchases & Returns belongs to one purchase channel, and the channel fixes who may buy on it, what it sells and the smallest order it accepts. This schedule sets those terms for all six channels.

## Membership and segment terms

| Channel | Membership presented | Sells only to an active membership | Open only to business-segment memberships | Non-member surcharge on merchandise |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate In-Club Purchase | active membership card presented at the register | yes | no | 0 percent |
| Northgate Club Pickup Order | active membership at checkout on Northgate.com or the app | yes | no | 0 percent |
| Northgate Same-Day Delivery Order | active membership linked in the delivery partner's app | yes | no | 0 percent |
| Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order | none required; non-members pay the non-member surcharge | no | no | 5 percent |
| Northgate Business Delivery Order | active Business or Business Plus membership | yes | yes | 0 percent |
| Northgate Special Order | active membership; ordered at a club special-order kiosk or by phone | yes | no | 0 percent |

## Assortment, order minimum, fulfilment partner and Annual Reward

| Channel | Merchandise classes the channel does not sell | Minimum pre-tax merchandise total | Shopped and delivered by a delivery partner | Purchases can earn Annual Reward |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate In-Club Purchase | none | 0.00 (no minimum) | no | yes |
| Northgate Club Pickup Order | gasoline; tires and batteries | 0.00 (no minimum) | no | yes |
| Northgate Same-Day Delivery Order | gasoline; tires and batteries; major appliance; mattress and furniture; jewelry and watch; Shop Card and gift card | 35.00 | yes | no |
| Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order | gasoline; tobacco and alcohol; tires and batteries | 0.00 (no minimum) | no | yes |
| Northgate Business Delivery Order | gasoline; tobacco and alcohol; jewelry and watch; cell phone | 250.00 | no | yes |
| Northgate Special Order | gasoline; tobacco and alcohol; grocery; Shop Card and gift card | 0.00 (no minimum) | no | yes |

Amounts are in USD. An order minimum of 0.00 means the channel has no minimum.

## Reading the schedule

- **Who pays the surcharge.** The Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order is the only channel that sells without an active membership, and the only channel with a non-zero surcharge (5 percent of merchandise). On every other channel the surcharge figure is 0 percent.
- **Partner-fulfilled orders.** The Northgate Same-Day Delivery Order is the one channel shopped and delivered by a delivery partner rather than by Northgate.
- **Business-only channel.** The Northgate Business Delivery Order is the one channel restricted to business-segment memberships; it also carries the highest order minimum, 250.00.

Hypothetical illustration: a basket of 30.00 of grocery placed for same-day delivery is below that channel's 35.00 minimum; the same basket placed as a Club Pickup Order meets that channel's minimum of 0.00.
